hook: In the first second Mom's quick 'Pass the potatoes' plays over a wide of the crowded table with Rick already aiming his fork at Aiden. By second 2 Rick's smug push-in and his jab ('still doing your little internet trading?') set up the public humiliation. Viewers stop for a family showdown they recognise.

scenes.heading: INT. DINING ROOM — THANKSGIVING
scenes.look: Warm but harsh overhead chandelier light on a crowded table, steam off the turkey and relatives packed in the background who laugh on cue, while Aiden sits in a cooler pool of shadow at the end.

shots.speaker: Mom
shots.action: Mom reaches for the potato bowl as Rick, across the packed table, already levels his fork at Aiden.
shots.camera: Wide eye-level shot down the length of the table, quick drift in

shots.speaker: Uncle Rick
shots.line: So Aiden, still doing your little internet trading?
shots.action: Rick jabs his fork across the table at Aiden.
shots.reaction: Rick's grin stretches smug and wide.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Rick, quick push-in

shots.speaker: Aiden
shots.action: Aiden answers calmly, setting his fork down.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Aiden, static

shots.speaker: Uncle Rick
shots.line: Going well? You live in your mom's basement.
shots.action: Rick leans back and spreads his arms to the table, playing to the crowd.
shots.camera: Low-angle close-up on Rick, fast push-in

shots.action: The whole table bursts out laughing.
shots.reaction: Relatives throw their heads back and slap the table.
shots.camera: Wide shot of the table, slight handheld shake

shots.action: Aiden grips his fork, the only one not laughing.
shots.reaction: Aiden's face burns red, knuckles white on the fork.
shots.camera: Close-up on Aiden, isolated in shallow focus with laughing blurs around him

shots.speaker: Mom
shots.action: Mom shoots Rick a sharp look.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Mom, static

shots.action: The laughter dies as Aiden stares Rick down.
shots.reaction: Aiden's eyes lock on Rick, unblinking.
shots.camera: Tight close-up on Aiden's eyes, slow push-in

shots.speaker: Aiden
shots.action: Aiden says it quietly, never breaking eye contact.
shots.reaction: Rick's smirk flickers for half a second.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up on Aiden, static, hold

shots.action: Aiden shoves his chair back, throws his napkin on his plate and storms off.
shots.reaction: The table goes silent, heads turning to follow him.
shots.camera: Wide shot from Rick's end of the table, Aiden exiting frame

scenes.heading: INT. AIDEN'S BASEMENT ROOM — NIGHT
scenes.look: Cramped dark room in cold blue, lit only by phone and monitor glow on Aiden's face; it drains redder on the loss and flares green and warm on the win, while seasons change in the small window behind him.

shots.action: Aiden's thumb taps fomo open and the home screen fills his phone.
shots.camera: Macro insert, phone fills the frame, static

shots.action: The token's red line drops on his phone as the trade goes bad.
shots.camera: Macro insert of the phone screen, static

shots.action: Aiden slams his fist on the desk, rattling an energy can.
shots.reaction: Aiden squeezes his eyes shut, jaw clenched.
shots.camera: High isolated wide over the desk, hard jolt on impact

shots.action: Aiden's hands work the keyboard in front of the desktop trading screen, night after night.
shots.camera: Insert over the hands onto the monitor, slow push-in

shots.action: Monitor glow lights Aiden's focused face as the window behind him shifts from snow to spring rain to summer sun.
shots.reaction: Aiden's eyes narrow, steady and determined.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Aiden facing the monitor, static time-lapse

shots.action: The token's line climbs on Aiden's phone.
shots.camera: Macro insert, phone fills the frame, static

shots.action: Aiden leans back in his chair, green light washing over him.
shots.reaction: A slow, quiet grin spreads across his face.
shots.camera: Low-angle close-up, slow push-in

scenes.heading: INT. DINING ROOM — THANKSGIVING, ONE YEAR LATER
scenes.look: Same table in warm golden candlelight, richer and softer than last year, with relatives in the background leaning in to watch and Aiden now sitting in the light.

shots.action: Aiden's hand rests on his phone, face-down beside his plate.
shots.camera: Close insert on the hand and phone, static

shots.speaker: Uncle Rick
shots.action: Rick smirks over his plate, fork raised.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Rick, quick push-in

shots.action: Aiden calmly slides his phone across the tablecloth toward Rick.
shots.camera: Low tracking shot along the tabletop following the phone

shots.action: The phone stops in front of Rick, the climbing token chart on screen.
shots.camera: Top-down insert on the phone, static

shots.action: Rick's fork freezes mid-air.
shots.camera: Close-up on Rick, snap zoom

shots.action: Mom lifts her glass to hide her smile.
shots.reaction: Mom's eyes shine with pride over the rim.
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Mom, static

shots.speaker: Uncle Rick
shots.action: Rick leans down to the phone, voice cracking.
shots.camera: Tight close-up on Rick, slow push-in

shots.speaker: Aiden
shots.action: Aiden leans back in his chair, relaxed, and holds out his hand.
shots.reaction: Aiden gives a small, confident smile.
shots.camera: Low-angle medium close-up on Aiden, slow push-in, hold

clips.seam: Hard cut from the dining room to Aiden's basement room that night.
Hard cut to Thanksgiving one year later.
